
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19485861" title="发布于 2026-01-15 09:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DBShadow横空出世,Dapper.net的天花板盖不住了</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Dapper以前做为.net下ORM的性能天花板
DBShadow性能更好,功能更全面
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一dbshadow是什么">一、DBShadow是什么</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>DBShadow是.net开源的高性能ORM</li>
<li>DBShadow使用开源项目ShadowSql高效拼接sql</li>
<li>DBShadow使用开源项目PocoEmit.Mapper高效映射查询参数和查询结果</li>
<li>也就是说SqlBuilder(ShadowSql)+OOM(PocoEmit.Mapper)=ORM(DBShadow)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二dbshadow和dapper对比一下">二、DBShadow和Dapper对比一下</h2>
<h3 id="1-dapper代码">1. Dapper代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">await using var conn = _dataSource.CreateConnection();
var sql = "SELECT \"Id\",\"Title\",\"Content\",\"Done\",\"LastTime\" FROM \"Todo\" WHERE \"Id\"=@Id";
var first = await conn.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync&lt;Todo&gt;(sql, _todo);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">DbDataSource _dataSource = new StringDataSource("Data Source=file::memory:;Cache=Shared", conn =&gt; new SqliteConnection(conn));
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-dbshadow代码">2. DBShadow代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用SqliteEngine处理数据库方言</li>
<li>使用Mapper.Default处理类型映射</li>
<li>ShadowCachedBuilder用来编译和缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var first = await _shadowSelect.GetFirstAsync&lt;Todo, Todo?&gt;(_executor, _todo);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">ISqlEngine engine = new SqliteEngine();
ShadowExecutor _executor = ShadowBuilder.CreateCache(engine, Mapper.Default);
TodoTable _table = new("Todo");
ISelect _shadowSelect_shadowSelect = _table.ToQuery()
    .And(_table.Id.Equal())
    .ToSelect()
    .SelectSelfColumns();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-用benchmarkdotnet对比一下">3. 用BenchmarkDotNet对比一下</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>DBShadow比Dapper快10%</li>
<li>内存也占优</li>
<li>以下是基于.net8,DBShadow支持.net10,Dapper没有.net10版本</li>
<li>为了公平降级对比</li>
<li>其实DBShadow在.net10下更快</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="三再用mysql对比一下">三、再用Mysql对比一下</h2>
<h3 id="1-dapper代码-1">1. Dapper代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">await using var conn = _dataSource.CreateConnection();
var sql = "SELECT `Id`,`Title`,`Content`,`Done`,`LastTime` FROM `Todo` WHERE `Id`=@Id";
var first = await conn.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync&lt;Todo&gt;(sql, _todo);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">string ConnectionString = "Server=localhost;Database=Benchmarks;User=root;Password=123456;";
DbDataSource _dataSource = new MySqlDataSource(ConnectionString);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-dbshadow代码-1">2. DBShadow代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用MySqlEngine处理数据库方言</li>
<li>使用Mapper.Default处理类型映射</li>
<li>ShadowCachedBuilder用来编译和缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var first = await _shadowSelect.GetFirstAsync&lt;Todo, Todo?&gt;(_executor, _todo);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">ISqlEngine engine = new MySqlEngine();
ShadowCachedBuilder _executor = ShadowBuilder.CreateCache(engine, Mapper.Default);
TodoTable _table = new("Todo");
ISelect _shadowSelect_shadowSelect = _table.ToQuery()
    .And(_table.Id.Equal())
    .ToSelect()
    .SelectSelfColumns();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-再用benchmarkdotnet对比一下">3. 再用BenchmarkDotNet对比一下</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>DBShadow比Dapper只快3%</li>
<li>内存占优</li>
<li>由于MySql耗时几乎是Sqlite的100倍,执行代码是一样的(能快3%就很不容易了)</li>
<li>MySql慢也与我本机资源限制有关,使用docker搭建MySql,也没用固态硬盘(固态硬盘用在系统盘)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="四dbshadow支持事务操作">四、DBShadow支持事务操作</h2>
<h3 id="1-举个事务回滚的栗子">1. 举个事务回滚的栗子</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>建表Accounts</li>
<li>账号1初始化余额为100</li>
<li>查询账号1余额为100</li>
<li>开启事务</li>
<li>使用事务把余额设置为90</li>
<li>在事务下查询余额为90</li>
<li>事务回滚</li>
<li>再次查询账号1余额为100</li>
<li>DBShadow事务操作很优雅</li>
<li>是否事务只与使用哪个处理器或数据源有关</li>
<li>正常处理器或数据源可以很方便的转化为事务相关对象</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var table = new AccountTable();
try
{
    await SqliteExecutor.ExecuteAsync(table.ToCreate()); // 建表Accounts
}
catch { }
await new SingleInsert(table)
    .Insert(table.Id.InsertValue(1L))
    .Insert(table.Amount.InsertValue(100L))
    .ExecuteAsync(SqliteExecutor); // 账号1初始化余额为100
// 查询账号1
var query = table.ToSqlQuery().Where("Id=1");
var amount = await query
    .ToSelect()
    .Select(account =&gt; account.Amount)
    .GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(SqliteExecutor); // 查询账号1余额为100
Assert.Equal(100L, amount);
// 开启事务
await using var transaction = await SqliteExecutor.BeginTransaction();
{
    await query.ToUpdate()
        .Set(account =&gt; account.Amount.AssignValue(90L))
        .ExecuteAsync(transaction); // 使用事务把余额设置为90
    var amount2 = await query
        .ToSelect()
        .Select(account =&gt; account.Amount)
        .GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(transaction); // 在事务下查询余额为90
    // 减成了90
    Assert.Equal(90L, amount2);
    // 事务回滚
    await transaction.RollbackAsync();
}
var amount3 = await query
    .ToSelect()
    .Select(account =&gt; account.Amount)
    .GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(SqliteExecutor);
// 回滚后恢复为100
Assert.Equal(100L, amount3);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-再举个事务提交和预编译的栗子">2. 再举个事务提交和预编译的栗子</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>事务提交和事务回滚特别相近,为此增加DBShadow预编译的内容</li>
<li>建表预编译</li>
<li>插入操作预编译</li>
<li>查询账号余额预编译</li>
<li>修改账号余额预编译</li>
<li>建表Accounts</li>
<li>账号1初始化余额为100</li>
<li>查询账号1余额为100</li>
<li>开启事务</li>
<li>使用事务把余额设置为90</li>
<li>在事务下查询余额为90</li>
<li>事务提交</li>
<li>再次查询账号1余额为90</li>
<li>预编译能提高执行性能和稳定性</li>
<li>在事务操作之前预编译很有必要</li>
<li>预编译之后的结果对是否事务数据源都是一样的使用方式(也就是业务代码可以做到通用)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var builder = SqliteExecutor.Builder;
var table = new AccountTable();        
var query = table.ToSqlQuery().Where("Id=1");

#region Compile
// 建表预编译
var createCompiled = builder.BuildQuery(table.ToCreate());
// 插入操作预编译
var insertCompiled = builder.BuildQuery(new SingleInsert(table)
    .Insert(table.Id.InsertValue(1L))
    .Insert(table.Amount.InsertValue(100L)));
// 查询账号余额预编译
var amountCompiled = builder.BuildScalar(query
    .ToSelect()
    .Select(account =&gt; account.Amount));
// 修改账号余额预编译
var updateCompiled = builder.BuildQuery(query.ToUpdate()
    .Set(account =&gt; account.Amount.AssignValue(90L)));
#endregion

try
{
    await createCompiled.ExecuteAsync(SqliteSource); // 建表Accounts
}
catch { }
await insertCompiled.ExecuteAsync(SqliteSource); // 账号1初始化余额为100
var amount = await amountCompiled.GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(SqliteSource); // 查询账号1余额为100
Assert.Equal(100L, amount);
// 开启事务
await using var transaction = await SqliteSource.BeginTransaction();
{
    await updateCompiled.ExecuteAsync(transaction); // 使用事务把余额设置为90
    var amount2 = await amountCompiled.GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(transaction); // 在事务下查询余额为90
    Assert.Equal(90L, amount2);
    await transaction.CommitAsync(); // 事务提交
}
var amount3 = await amountCompiled.GetScalarAsync&lt;long&gt;(SqliteSource); // 再次查询账号1余额为90
Assert.Equal(90L, amount3);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五dbshadow解密">五、DBShadow解密</h2>
<h3 id="1-首先dbshadow基于现代adonet">1. 首先DBShadow基于现代ADO.net</h3>
<h4 id="11-dbdatasource">1.1 DbDataSource</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>数据连接基于System.Data.Common.DbDataSource</li>
<li>DbDataSource的重要方法CreateConnection</li>
<li>相当于数据库连接工厂或连接池</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="12-stringdatasource">1.2 StringDataSource</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>虽然微软推出DbDataSource很多年了,但是业界支持的并不是很好</li>
<li>比如Sqlite不支持DbDataSource</li>
<li>就算是System.Data也只能.net7+才支持</li>
<li>这个破破烂烂的世界,需要缝缝补补</li>
<li>StringDataSource支持net4.5+和netstandard2.0+</li>
<li>在.net7+下StringDataSource是DbDataSource的子类</li>
<li>其他情况下DBShadow使用StringDataSource直接代替DbDataSource</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="13-iasyncenumerable">1.3 IAsyncEnumerable&lt;&gt;</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这是异步下的迭代器</li>
<li>在异步操作IO流下实现延迟加载和流式计算</li>
<li>DBShadow的列表都是基于IAsyncEnumerable&lt;&gt;</li>
<li>EFCore也支持IAsyncEnumerable&lt;&gt;,但Dapper不支持</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="2-shadowsql">2. ShadowSql</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用ShadowSql拼接sql</li>
<li>ShadowSql也是笔者的开源项目,之前就有很多相关的介绍</li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/18909458" target="_blank">ShadowSql.net之正确使用方式</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="3-pocoemitmapper">3. PocoEmit.Mapper</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>使用PocoEmit.Mapper来映射</li>
<li>把参数映射为SqlParameter</li>
<li>把DataReader映射为实体</li>
<li>使得DBShadow继承了PocoEmit.Mapper的可配置性、可扩展性和依赖注入等功能,这些EFCore和Dapper都是做不到的</li>
<li>PocoEmit.Mapper也是笔者的开源项目,之前就有很多相关的介绍</li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19059979" target="_blank">婶可忍叔不可忍的AutoMapper,你还用吗?</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19062936" target="_blank">如何使用PocoEmit.Mapper替代AutoMapper</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19125327" target="_blank">PocoEmit遥遥领先于AutoMapper之打通充血模型的任督二脉</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="4-dbshadow为啥能比dapper快">4. DBShadow为啥能比Dapper快</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Dapper通过正则表达式提取参数</li>
<li>而DBShadow从ShadowSql的语义中获取参数</li>
<li>对于ShadowSql参数本身就是个独立语义对象,很容易提取</li>
<li>从ShadowSql中也可以提取到字段名可以通过预编译进行加速</li>
<li>DBShadow必须明确是否有参数,形参类型明确,这样才好提前优化</li>
<li>DBShadow不支持动态类型作为参数和返回类型,也是为了提前编译优化</li>
<li>DBShadow基于ShadowSql明确的语义</li>
<li>DBShadow支持预编译</li>
<li>而Dapper基于sql的通用语法及各种方言,只能各种兼容,拖累了性能</li>
<li>当然也有ShadowSql和PocoEmit的高性能加持</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>另外源码托管地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/DBShadow.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/DBShadow.net</a> ，欢迎大家直接查看源码。<br>
gitee同步更新:<a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/DBShadow.net" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/DBShadow.net</a></p>
